title: mirabilis expansa
intro: Mirabilis expansa, commonly known as Wild Four O'Clock, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the four o'clock family (Nyctaginaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The health benefits of Mirabilis expansa include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Mirabilis expansa include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as sedation, analgesia, and antispasmodic effects.
